description:
Job Title: Analyst II 
 Duration: 12 Months 
 Location: Hicksville, NY 
 
 Duties 
 • Execute cloud vision by providing technical expertise/guidance in cloud technologies 
 • Provide proven infrastructure deployments through continuous configuration automation (patterns and repeatable code). 
 • Provide operational support for Cloud environment, inclusive of network, storage, compute, OS, and application services. 
 • Work with business units to enable migrations from on premise deployments to a public cloud environment. 
 • Develop an agile deployment process to improve time to market for infrastructure request. 
 • Work with a team of Architects/Engineers to develop approaches for cloud services. 
 Skills 
 • Well versed in cloud constructs from AWS, Azure, and other Tier 1 providers. 
 • Proven ability with java, powershell, or 3rd party software tools to create and deploy infrastructure as code. 
 • Proven design, planning and implementation experience with all infrastructure components including Storage, Network, and Compute technologies. 
 • Experience with enterprise architectures a plus 
 • Experience in developing low level designs 
 • Work as part of team to execute regionally while maintaining a global view.
